'''Jaardu Raax''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime lord]] who was the leader of the Scourge that remained on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Following the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], Jaardu Raax was known as a mass murderer when he killed a number of innocent citizens when he set off thermal detonators on a busy Coruscant market street. He was captured by the Republic and was given a life sentence on Belsavis, but that has not stopped his violent ways when he remained on that planet for [[Standard year/Legends|years]].
